functions.purpose: A finite score the SEARCH algorithms optimize toward, distinct from the hard pass/fail that decides who can actually win. Without this, a rejected candidate scores -inf, TPE's history only ever grows from finite scores, and when every phase-1 candidate is rejected (which is exactly what happened on the real 48-symbol, 10-candidate run), TPE never gets a single observation to learn from and phase 2/3 never even start — CalibrationSupervisor.run() used to bail out right there. functions.purpose: Fit (or refit) the HMM model on current trailing features. CRITICAL: Uses zlib.crc32(symbol) % (2**31) for random_state, NOT Python's hash(symbol). findings.claim: revision3 MasterControlSystem PID evaluator is explicitly a no-op returning no-exit even when PID is enabled.
findings.impact: Cannot supply claimed three-layer continuous exit controller. This prototype is distinct from external R5 controllers.
findings.action: Mark prototype unavailable; define and integrate actuator contract before considering this path. No implementation changes in this audit.

findings.claim: Master decision wrapper supplies a one-element stock array; macro Hilbert phase gate permits insufficient (<63) history.
findings.impact: Phase synchronization can report successful without a measurable stock phase in this wrapper.
findings.action: Require independently timestamp-aligned causal stock/index windows and an explicit insufficient-history disposition.

findings.claim: Revision3ProtectedSupervisor checks only preflight and substitutes healthy telemetry/zero exposure when absent; engine exceptions return {}.
findings.impact: Preflight wrapper does not provide continuous measured plant safety or authoritative close receipts. Empty report obscures fault provenance.
findings.action: Keep separate from real measured protection; require caller-sourced telemetry and structured failure receipts for any future use.

findings.claim: Revision3SafetyPanel master_reset clears lockout without validating external safety invariants.
findings.impact: Atomic lock is present, but reset policy claimed in docstring is not implemented.
findings.action: Define measured-reset preconditions and operator receipt before operational use.

findings.claim: Legacy grid volatility denominator is calculated from entire loaded NIFTY history rather than the causal prefix.
findings.impact: If future bars are loaded, voltage-frequency phase decisions include future-dependent normalization. This module is not instantiated by listed vanilla orchestrators.
findings.action: Use prefix-only baseline if reviving legacy grid; establish timestamp alignment and missing-data policy.

findings.claim: Revision4 PipelineAdapter uses undefined entry_cost_pct/fixed_cost, creates BUY-only plans, and does not veto grid_sync=False.
findings.impact: Earlier ReplayEngine path can suppress failures as rejected candidates and cannot support symmetric end-to-end trading. Authoritative sealed validator uses different adapters.
findings.action: Label this earlier path non-authoritative and quarantine from system completeness claims; repair only under a separate approved scope.

findings.claim: Revision4 replay_engine processes symbols serially and submits pending orders without any broker.try_fill_order call in the replay methods.
findings.impact: Order counts do not establish completed fills/trades or shared chronological portfolio execution in this prototype.
findings.action: Use authoritative timestamp validator; mark old ReplayEngine unsuitable as acceptance evidence.

findings.claim: ten_box_orchestrator_clean is a pass-only scaffold for most advertised boxes despite header claims.
findings.impact: Defined interfaces and instantiated classes are not ten operational boxes. run_replay reports INCOMPLETE.
findings.action: Do not count scaffold boxes as delivered implementation; retain as interface documentation or retire explicitly.

findings.claim: Revision4 box_adapters computes pid_info but does not apply entry_timing_multiplier to PositionManager sizing.
findings.impact: MPC entry PID is not completely disconnected: reference price and geometry still change; sizing advice specifically has no actuator in this callback path.
findings.action: Document per-path actuator differences; separately approve an isolation fix if desired, without editing sealed baseline.

findings.claim: Revision4 exit callback sets peak_equity and current_equity to the same snapshot mark.
findings.impact: Its local drawdown/daily-loss liquidation calculations are always zero. Other presubmit gates/ledger safeguards exist, so this is not proof all protection is absent.
findings.action: Trace historical peak/day baseline into this specific exit protection contract in a future approved change.

findings.claim: ProperGateEvaluator discards adjusted quantities returned by drawdown/lambda derating gates.
findings.impact: Gate pass/fail is connected, but quantity reductions do not flow into actual order size through this wrapper.
findings.action: Record gate-adjusted quantity and propagate explicitly before reservation/submission if changing this sealed path is authorized.

findings.claim: ProperGateEvaluator only sets slippage in SafetyGateConfig and assumes healthy feed/broker; duplication input is always False.
findings.impact: Several gate thresholds come from gate dataclass defaults rather than effective registry config; historical placeholders do not prove live health.
findings.action: Expose exact policy sources and real runtime inputs; keep historical gate claims bounded to replay context.

findings.claim: Revision4 ledger uses fixed 5 slots, 2x exposure and abs(daily_pnl)>2000 reconciliation threshold.
findings.impact: Positive profits beyond2000 also fail the absolute daily-P&L check; parameter changes do not necessarily change all portfolio limits.
findings.action: Document immutable safety policy versus accidental literal; do not silently tune sealed constants.

findings.claim: PortfolioSnapshot unrealized_pnl is equity minus cash minus starting_cash minus realized_pnl.
findings.impact: This is not the usual signed marked P&L relative to position entry; downstream reliance requires explicit reconciliation. Marked equity calculation itself is separate.
findings.action: Compare snapshot unrealized field to authoritative signed position marks; capture a defect fixture before any approved repair.

findings.claim: DatasetValidator seal uses literal HEAD/v1_68_params/baseline provenance and fixed August2024 dates.
findings.impact: CSV hashes are actually computed, but those code/config labels do not identify immutable real blobs.
findings.action: Distinguish measured dataset identity from placeholder provenance; use resolved hashes in future manifests.

findings.claim: CanonicalConfigBuilder.validate_config skips numeric bounds if either bound is zero.
findings.impact: Zero-minimum parameter bounds may not be checked in this older helper; full canonical payload validation is separate.
findings.action: Use canonical validation rather than helper for production decisions; add zero-bound fixture if revisiting.

findings.claim: Calibration _trade_pnl uses trade.get(net_pnl, trade[pnl]); Python evaluates default eagerly.
findings.impact: Net-only trade dictionaries raise KeyError despite intended fallback semantics; current legacy trade dictionaries usually include both.
findings.action: Use explicit presence check in an approved helper repair; do not infer current reports fail without payload evidence.

findings.claim: Older in-house single-symbol and portfolio orchestrators use wall-clock fallback on malformed timestamps and carry synthetic ID RR to final gates.
findings.impact: Malformed-time replay can lose determinism; gate RR may reflect confidence proxy rather than final target/stop geometry in these paths. External R5 has its own separate geometry gate.
findings.action: Require explicit invalid-time disposition and identify each path RR source before comparing gate evidence.

findings.claim: Sealed V3 validator partitions by session and explicitly EOD-flattens remaining positions.
findings.impact: This sealed V3 intraday contract deliberately has no overnight Engine B lifecycle; absence is design scope, not evidence of broken broker conversion.
findings.action: Preserve sealed reference; implement combined cycle as opt-in separately, never relabel this validator as an overnight plant.

findings.claim: Empirical entry-probability validator rejects signature buckets with fewer than20 historical outcomes.
findings.impact: An unseeded wrapper cannot bootstrap accepted trades; zero-loss claims are unsupported empirical thresholds.
findings.action: Label experimental, identify source/causal boundaries of seed outcomes, and avoid interpreting win fractions as guaranteed forecasts.

findings.claim: ProperGateEvaluator._evaluate_gate returns Gate09 evaluate tuple directly, while evaluate_pre_submission expects decision.passed.
findings.impact: When this gate is reached with frozen Gate09 implementation, tuple has no passed attribute and historical wrapper cannot complete that admission. Static cross-file contract mismatch, not a newly executed failure.
findings.action: Align Gate09 returned quantity/decision contract in an separately approved repair; preserve sealed artifact provenance.

controllers.name: In-house bounded PID primitive
controllers.loaded_by: ModelPredictiveControlBox._get_pid; in-house orchestrators and Revision4 sealed callback adapter
controllers.error: target-current_value; target assigned recent prior decision.confidence mean
controllers.feedback: decision.confidence at approved plan construction; not realized R or broker fills
controllers.actuator: returns adjustment = kp*error + ki*clip(sum(last window errors),±clamp) + kd*mean(last smoothing error differences)
controllers.authority: Numeric helper only; downstream plan/sizing owns actuation
controllers.limitations: Finite window/clamp anti-windup present; no explicit dt. Not a fleet PID. PID initialization gains persist until object reset.

controllers.name: In-house MPC entry confidence PID
controllers.error: prior confidence mean minus current admitted confidence
controllers.feedback: Confidence sequence for generated plans; no feedback from actual waiting/fill quality
controllers.authority: Sizing advice applied by vanilla Revision2; Revision4 callback omits multiplier while still using plan geometry
controllers.limitations: No delayed entry/wait-for-better-bar state. Price reference nudge differs from actual next-open fills. Confidence magnitude not success probability.

controllers.name: In-house MPC exit confidence PID
controllers.loaded_by: Same plan-construction callers as entry PID
controllers.error: Shared prior confidence mean minus current admitted confidence
controllers.feedback: Entry-plan confidence only, no held-bar or realized path feedback
controllers.authority: Shapes initial plan; it is not continuously invoked by held-position exit loop
controllers.limitations: Vanilla _maybe_exit uses fixed plan stop/target and signal exit rather than calling this PID. Distinct from external ContinuousExitController.

controllers.name: Revision3 master PID façade
controllers.feedback: Accepts PA/studies/price/ATR/state but does not consume them into PID
controllers.limitations: Enabled flag is not functional PID integration; caller cannot obtain exit from this method.

controllers.name: Revision3 preflight protection relay
controllers.error: Threshold comparisons on caller telemetry/exposure; not PID error
controllers.actuator: Returns{} to block full run, else delegates
controllers.limitations: Defaults healthy and zero-exposure. No per-bar broker close/protection reconciliation. Not sealed V3.

controllers.name: Revision3 macro synchronizer
controllers.error: Signed index close minus EMA and absolute wrapped Hilbert phase difference
controllers.authority: Caller-mediated entry gate; no direct order authority
controllers.limitations: Not PID; <63 phase history bypass; one-close master caller defeats measurable phase.

controllers.name: Legacy NIFTY heuristic grid
controllers.loaded_by: No constructor connection in listed vanilla Revision2 orchestrators; explicit caller required
controllers.error: No PID; voltage abs(last return)/std, frequency trailing std/full-loaded std
controllers.feedback: Loaded NIFTY indexed by integer bar index
controllers.actuator: PA multiplier, threshold multiplier, exit-tightness suggestion if consumed
controllers.authority: Advisory output only absent caller actuation
controllers.limitations: Future-dependent full-feed denominator; missing data entry-allow fallback.

controllers.name: Sealed V3 chart/grid supplemental boxes
controllers.error: No PID: momentum/RSI/VWAP confirmation and average close-open universe return sign
controllers.feedback: Completed current symbol history and contemporaneous bars
controllers.actuator: Entry bool veto and stop/target/maxhold ExitEvent suggestions
controllers.authority: Connected callback decisions inside historical sealed replay
controllers.limitations: Not same as R5 studies-weight PID/governor grid. Full qualified-box call counts measure visits, not actuator effectiveness.

controllers.name: Offline economic calibration supervisory feedback
controllers.error: Candidate score/acceptance metrics against reporting constraints, not plant PID error
controllers.actuator: Selects next registry-bounded trial parameter payload / reports winner
controllers.authority: Offline experiment selection; no direct broker authority
controllers.limitations: Must not classify as unconnected trading control simply because offline. Frozen safety excluded. Train/validation dates belong to caller.
